includes: Year-end accounts in the format your regulator expects

includes: VAT return prepared from your books
Figures checked against your bank records
Filed under Making Tax Digital after you approve

includes: Income and expenses summarised each quarter
Quarterly update sent after you approve

includes: Payslips every pay day
RTI submissions (FPS and EPS) to HMRC
P60s at year end and P45s for leavers

complianceAddons.name: Confirmation statement

includes: Company details checked with you
Statement filed at Companies House (the Companies House fee is charged on top)

complianceAddons.forWho: Limited companies that did not trade during the year
includes: Dormant accounts filed at Companies House
A check that the company really was dormant

packages.name: VAT return filing
includes: Sales and purchases reconciled to your books for the quarter
Output and input VAT checked against your tax invoices
VAT 201 return prepared box by box, with working papers
Ready to submit before the deadline, with the payment amount

packages.name: VAT registration
packages.forWho: Businesses at or near the registration threshold
includes: Taxable turnover checked against the mandatory and voluntary thresholds
Documents collected and the EmaraTax application prepared
Answers to any FTA clarification requests drafted for you

packages.name: Corporate tax registration
packages.forWho: Companies and free zone entities that need a corporate tax TRN
includes: Your registration deadline worked out from your licence
Documents collected and the EmaraTax application prepared
Your first tax period and return due date confirmed in writing

packages.name: Corporate tax return
packages.forWho: Mainland companies and free zone entities, one tax period
includes: Accounting profit adjusted to taxable income
Small Business Relief and free zone treatment checked where they apply
Corporate tax return prepared, with a computation you can keep on file

packages.name: E-invoicing readiness review
packages.forWho: Businesses that must go live on e-invoicing in 2027
includes: Your invoices checked for the fields e-invoicing will require
Customer and supplier TRNs and VAT treatment checked
A written list of what to fix before your go-live date
